svg.title: Mean light use efficiency of the days 15 to 28 after the last day of a silage harvest, as a fraction of the LUE of the 14 days before the harvest, against the SPI-1 of the harvest month; one marker per episode, first cuts (n = 11) and later cuts (n = 5); a dashed line marks the dry limit SPI-1 = −1.5.
svg.desc: Two panels side by side with the same axes: first cuts (left) and later cuts (right). X axis: SPI-1 of the harvest month, from −2.75 to 2.75; a dashed vermillion vertical line at −1.5 marks the dry limit (dry = at or left of it). Y axis: mean LUE of the days +15 to +28 as a fraction of the LUE of the days −14 to −1, from 0.00 to 1.75; thin lines mark 1 and 0. Marker per site: Anttila blue circle, Särkisuo orange square, Qvidja reddish purple diamond, Viikki black pentagon; an open marker is a flagged Viikki episode (establishment year or partial harvest), not in the group statistics. First cuts: qvidja-2019-06-11 SPI-1 −2.02, LUE 0.52; qvidja-2022-06-21 SPI-1 −1.69, LUE 1.10; qvidja-2023-06-19 SPI-1 −1.63, LUE 1.30; qvidja-2021-06-14 SPI-1 −1.32, LUE 0.41; qvidja-2018-06-12 SPI-1 −1.21, LUE 1.42; viikki-2024-06-14 SPI-1 −0.92, LUE 1.63 (flagged, open marker); viikki-2022-07-01 SPI-1 −0.54, LUE 1.12; anttila-2022-06-21 SPI-1 −0.01, LUE 1.03; sarkisuo-2022-06-30 SPI-1 −0.01, LUE 1.57; qvidja-2024-06-15 SPI-1 0.91, LUE 1.25; viikki-2023-08-17 SPI-1 2.23, LUE 0.86 (flagged, open marker). Later cuts: qvidja-2020-08-28 SPI-1 −2.11, LUE 1.28; anttila-2022-08-08 SPI-1 −0.05, LUE 0.74; sarkisuo-2022-08-15 SPI-1 −0.05, LUE 1.06; qvidja-2019-08-20 SPI-1 0.29, LUE 0.94; anttila-2023-07-19 SPI-1 1.06, LUE 0.75. Episodes without a late window (blocked or fewer than 12 LUE days): anttila-2023-06-21, qvidja-2018-09-23, qvidja-2023-08-21.
